name: Codex Lens
tagline: Your Codex chats on Even G2
description: Use your own Codex account from Even G2 and R1. Setup: install the companion, confirm or sign into your own account, then tap Scan companion QR and allow camera access. Codex Lens uses a live scanner where supported and Even's native camera otherwise. Multi-pass decoding handles monitor glare, rotation, crops, and contrast. Then browse chats, speak, or type entirely on the glasses. No developer account is bundled.
author: Sam Wolfsdell

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect through the encrypted Codex Lens relay to the user's own desktop companion.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Capture a held-to-talk voice prompt and send it to the user's paired Codex session.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Ask for phone-camera access when the user taps Scan companion QR. Decode the pairing QR locally; Codex Lens does not upload or retain the image.
